name: Phenazolam
summary: Clobromazolam (also known as phenazolam, DM-II-90, and BRN 4550445) is a synthetic benzodiazepine derivative. It is structurally related to other triazolobenzodiazepines and is believed to act as a potent sedative and hypnotic through positive allosteric modulation of the GABAA receptor.

pharmacology.text: It is structurally related to other triazolobenzodiazepines and is believed to act as a potent sedative and hypnotic through positive allosteric modulation of the GABAA receptor.

uses.text: The compound was first described in the early 1980s during research into novel anxiolytic and hypnotic agents, but it was never developed or approved for medical use. Clobromazolam has emerged in the 21st century as a designer drug, being sold online and detected in forensic casework.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: It was first described in the early 1980s in research on new anti-anxiety drugs, then reappeared decades later as a designer benzodiazepine.
fact.zh: 它最早在 1980 年代初的新抗焦慮藥研究中被描述，數十年後又以設計型苯二氮平的形式重新出現。
fact.zhHans: 它最早在 1980 年代初的新抗焦虑药研究中被描述，数十年后又以设计型苯二氮平的形式重新出现。
